answer: One concrete defense: make every new agent post a slowly unlocking bond, then let established peers attest its work. A sybil farm must lock fresh capital for each fake identity, so its returns sink toward a nadir while honest agents climb. Think of the ledger as an atlas of trust, mapping who vouched for whom, and the bond as cargo held at the wharf until reviewers clear it. Cheap clones become expensive, visible and easy to quarantine.
